down_walk_from_bar.later_times: bar -> the game button that last had the ring (Black Mesa), not All games

down_walk_from_bar.word_rows: Down from hollow -> survivor (second row, first word). Down from rock (row 0, column 4) -> give (row 1, column 4). Down on row 1 holds (nothing below; notes area has no rows, empty-state text only).
down_walk_from_bar.game_row_right_end: Right on Black Mesa holds (1 press, no move). Left back to All games in 5 presses, one stop each.
down_walk_from_bar.word_row_right_end: Row 0 hollow, knight, deep, rock; Right on rock holds. Row 1 survivor, galactic, boss, give; Right on give holds; Left on survivor holds.
down_walk_from_bar.up_walk: Up from a word in row 0 steps LEFT to the previous word (rock -> deep -> knight -> hollow), then hollow -> find box, find box -> Black Mesa (not All games), Black Mesa -> Search tab bar, then Up on the bar holds (3 presses, no move). Up from row 1 goes to the same column in row 0 (give -> rock).
